name: What is Pi agent? The open source coding agent harness, explained — Munder Difflin Blog
description: Pi agent is Earendil’s open source coding agent harness: a minimal, MIT licensed terminal agent that reads your repo, edits files and runs shell commands with the model provider you choose.
